select c.C_Name as peCompanyName, unit.C_Name as peUnitName, pc.C_Name as pBuildUnitName, c.C_Abbreviation as peCompanyAbbName, unit.C_Abbreviation as peUnitAbbName, pc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Name else con.con_Name end as conName, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Money else con.con_Money_Total end as conMoneyTotal, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Type else con.con_Type end as conType, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Code else con.con_Code end as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, u.U_Name as pePmName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, sr.Sc_Title as scTitle, sr.Sc_Name as scName, sr.Sc_Code as scCode,
from Pe_Info mn left join Con_Contract con on mn.Pe_Con_Id=con.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.Pe_Project_Id left join SYS_Company c on c.C_Id=mn.Pe_Company_Id left join SYS_Company unit on unit.C_Id=mn.Pe_Unit_Id left join SYS_Company pc on pc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_User u on mn.Pe_Pm_Uid=u.U_Id left join Subcontract_Record sr on mn.Pe_Sub_Contract=sr.Sc_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Pe_Id where mn.Pe_Id=#{peId}

select c.C_Name as peCompanyName, unit.C_Name as peUnitName, pc.C_Name as pBuildUnitName, c.C_Abbreviation as peCompanyAbbName, unit.C_Abbreviation as peUnitAbbName, pc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Name else con.con_Name end as conName, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Money else con.con_Money_Total end as conMoneyTotal, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Type else con.con_Type end as conType, case when mn.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Code else con.con_Code end as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, u.U_Name as pePmName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, sr.Sc_Title as scTitle, sr.Sc_Name as scName, sr.Sc_Code as scCode,
from Pe_Info mn left join Con_Contract con on mn.Pe_Con_Id=con.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.Pe_Project_Id left join SYS_Company c on c.C_Id=mn.Pe_Company_Id left join SYS_Company unit on unit.C_Id=mn.Pe_Unit_Id left join SYS_Company pc on pc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_User u on mn.Pe_Pm_Uid=u.U_Id left join Subcontract_Record sr on mn.Pe_Sub_Contract=sr.Sc_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Pe_Id where mn.Pe_Id in ( select Pe_Id from Pe_Meeting_Approval_List where Ma_Id=#{maId} )
